questions.question: Please provide the formal product schedule or written product-specific response confirming that the proposed entitlement is CRSP 1962 US Stock, product code C6Z, CIZ Flat File Format 2.0, and listing every included identity, security-history, exchange, security-type, active, inactive, and delisted table with coverage dates.
questions.why_mandatory: The project must prove the exact product, permanent tradable-security identity, historical validity intervals, security classification, and survivorship coverage before purchase.
questions.current_evidence: No CRSP vendor response, product schedule, entitlement, or quote was supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: The expected C6Z product and its table-level entitlement are not vendor-confirmed.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: A product-specific schedule or formal written response names C6Z/CIZ 2.0, confirms PERMNO and PERMCO semantics, identifies StkSecurityInfoHist and StkIssuerInfoHist or exact equivalents, and documents active and historical delisted coverage.

questions.question: Does the quoted C6Z entitlement include original unadjusted DlyOpen, DlyHigh, DlyLow, DlyClose, and DlyVol for all covered common-stock share classes from 2016-01-04 onward, and what are their units, missing-value rules, correction flags, session semantics, timezone, completeness time, and revision behavior?
questions.why_mandatory: Raw daily OHLCV and its usable-time semantics are mandatory for source admission and cannot be inferred from a generic daily-data description.
questions.current_evidence: No entitlement-specific schema, coverage census, methodology response, or delivery schedule was supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: Field inclusion, raw adjustment status, common-stock coverage, session meaning, and usable time are unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: An entitlement-specific schema and formal response identify all five fields, unadjusted semantics, units, missing values, session/date interpretation, timezone, delivery timing, correction policy, and coverage census.

questions.question: Please identify every corporate-action and terminal-event type included in the quoted C6Z entitlement, the exact StkDistributions and StkDelists fields or equivalents, event identifiers, PERMNO/PERMCO links, announcement/process/effective/release/revision dates, consideration terms, and predecessor/successor relationships.
questions.why_mandatory: The source contract requires event-level causal adjustment, identity changes, delisting representation, and terminal metadata without calculating outcomes.
questions.current_evidence: No product-specific action, distribution, delisting, or terminal-event entitlement was supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: Event census, field completeness, knowledge-time chronology, stable event identity, and terminal terms are unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: A formal product response and schema enumerate supported event types and fields, coverage, stable identifiers, all available dates, revision chronology, terms, and predecessor/successor links.

questions.question: Does the quoted entitlement include every as-received C6Z release from January 2016 onward, with original files, schemas, manifests, publication times, correction notes, release identifiers, and enough record/release chronology to reconstruct what was usable at each historical cutoff?
questions.why_mandatory: The frozen strict source contract requires historical releases or equivalent vintages; current corrected history and release notes alone are insufficient.
questions.current_evidence: No archive schedule, release census, manifests, revision chronology, publication metadata, or retention entitlement was supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: Historical archive availability, completeness, knowledge-time reconstruction, and lineage are unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: An incorporated entitlement or formal archive schedule identifies every deliverable from January 2016, version identifiers, manifests, publication times, correction history, delivery method, and continuing access/retention rights.

questions.question: Do the proposed binding terms permit automated Python and command-line processing, immutable local landing and hashing of original releases, internal normalized and point-in-time canonical panels, internal derived features and models, and nonredistributive internal research use?
questions.why_mandatory: The project cannot ingest or reproduce the source if local automation, immutable landing, or internal derivatives are prohibited or merely assumed.
questions.current_evidence: No proposed license, addendum, order form, or incorporated data-use terms were supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: Programmatic processing, immutable storage, normalized data, derived panels, features, and internal-model rights are unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: Binding contract language expressly permits the intended single-user local automated workflow, immutable source preservation, and nonredistributive internal derivatives.

questions.question: Do the proposed binding terms permit encrypted local backups and disaster-recovery copies and permanent retention after nonrenewal of original releases, archived vintages, schemas, manifests, normalized tables, canonical panels, derived features, model artifacts, and audit records?
questions.why_mandatory: Reproducible research requires recoverable source vintages and sufficient retention rights after subscription expiration.
questions.current_evidence: No license, retention clause, deletion obligation, backup term, or post-cancellation provision was supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: Backup scope, post-cancellation retention, deletion duties, and retention of reconstructive derivatives are unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: Binding terms specify allowed backup locations and permit sufficient raw and derived retention to reproduce historical research after nonrenewal, or identify an exact required amendment.

questions.question: Is an individual, sole practitioner, or noninstitutional researcher eligible for the quoted C6Z package, and what NYSE, Nasdaq, NYSE American, user/device reporting, audit, attribution, publication, redistribution, and separate exchange-agreement obligations apply?
questions.why_mandatory: Eligibility and third-party obligations can invalidate an otherwise suitable technical package or add unquoted costs and compliance duties.
questions.current_evidence: No customer classification, eligibility confirmation, exchange schedule, or redistribution terms were supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: The user's legal eligibility and all exchange, reporting, audit, attribution, publication, and redistribution obligations are unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: The quote and proposed binding terms identify the permitted customer class and every applicable exchange or third-party obligation, fee, restriction, and reporting duty.

questions.question: Please provide an itemized quote or order form for the exact C6Z package and January 2016 onward archive entitlement showing currency, quote and expiration dates, base subscription, bootstrap/archive, delivery, programmatic-access, exchange, setup, support, update and tax charges, minimum term, renewal price/escalation, cancellation terms, and required companion products.
questions.why_mandatory: A purchase decision cannot be ready while material mandatory costs, term, renewal, or bundled-product obligations are unknown.
questions.current_evidence: No quote, order form, price schedule, renewal schedule, or cost line item was supplied.
questions.exact_unresolved_point: Every initial, first-year, recurring, archive, exchange, setup, tax, and renewal amount is unknown.
questions.acceptable_answer_criteria: A current itemized quote tied to C6Z and the required archive identifies all mandatory and optional line items, totals, term, expiration, renewal, cancellation, and tax treatment.
